notes.title: Update 12 - Sacrifice
notes.content:
Hi, Adorers!

We are very excited to announce Major Update 12.

First of all, we'd like to thank you for your support during early access, you made this project a reality. Thank you very much!

As we already mentioned in another post: Update 12 contains all the content of version 1.0, so it can be considered an open beta of the final version. Basically, we didn't think it would be fair to hold the content until the game was ported to the other platforms (consoles).
You can check more details here: [LINK]

To begin, we rebalanced the entire game. The main story is finally complete and the idea is for players to experience more fluid gameplay during the campaign. For those who like a challenge, the endgame will provide greater difficulty.

Let's dive into other changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/19ad9fd17cdc39e7655987579b4c7324b9c6aee0.png


Main Changes

 New Main Story
 Quests rework
 New final boss
 Hunt
 Ascension Mode
 New Quests & Endgame Challenges
 Bestiary improved
 3 new endgame depths
 Achievements
 And much more!


Adore's Story
As the game evolved, so did the story. Adore now features a complete and immersive story.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2053114592655297045/168AA239B2739717650D419506AABB2016A23DC2/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Draknar, the God of Creatures is dead and a curse inflicted by Ixer is spreading, taking control of all creatures that inhabit Gatedrik. But the last spark of Draknar's flame fell on Lukha, an apprentice of the adorers and Draknar's last hope.
Lukha, during his journey to retrieve the Divine Essence and revive Draknar, not only discovers many secrets of the immense and mysterious world of Gaterdrik, but also perfects the art of taming and creating a strong bond with his creatures who will fight by his side.


Endgame activities
Completing the main story is just the beginning of your journey in Gaterdrik.
To help you complete your collection of creatures, even blessed and super-blessed, the Hunt mode was created.
If you prefer a challenge to test your ability to adapt to different situations, we have the Ascension mode.
And for those who want to prove themselves as adorers with their team of favorite creatures, you can venture into new depths.


Hunts
The name says it all, now experienced adorers will have the chance to hunt rare creatures more objectively. But of course, it won't be easy. 
Using essences, you'll have to track them down until you find them, and then you'll have the chance to capture the creature you want so much.
But don't let the opportunity slip away! Otherwise, you will have to re-track the creature.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2053114592655288769/8145A1CB772A87BC08CCD4580744C67725110437/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

To hunt a normal creature, a small essence will be needed, for a blessed creature, two small essences will be enough, and finally the super blessed creature, will need three medium essences.
Legendary creatures will not be out of the hunt, but will cost higher-level essences.


Ascension
How about a new way to test your true ability to adapt?
The best adorers are those who manage to take advantage of the situation presented to them. And creating the best team with the creatures available to you is a way to prove yourself to Draknar.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2053114592655334216/42AB43024C8A160FC21A13040B7AB8E267FC73ED/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

To complete, in this new mode, you will have to finish it using 6 different teams. Totaling 24 unique creatures used.
And each team will have to face a shorter version of an expedition.

Hi, adorers!
As we said in the devlogs, this is our last Major Update before 1.0 release. And we are so happy to be here with all of you.

We believe that Adore is much more fun when you play using multiple creatures in strategic ways instead of just spamming one creature.
Today, we want to talk a bit more about some changes that made the game much more engaging:

Number of enemies per area
To begin creating more engaging encounters, we reduced the number of creatures in each area and increased their level. This alone made a huge difference in the gameplay. 

New Damage & Armor Type 
Now, every attack of all creatures can have one of two types of damage: Physical  or Magical.
The armors also are divided into Physical and Magical armor:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/34da43e3cd36d4827973baaa6366873120ec716b.png
Basically, if you attack a physical armor with physical damage, it will work as before. The damage will be dealt to the armor until it reaches zero and breaks.

But here is where things get interesting, you can break the armor instantly:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/d790da79f6dc53fcadbadc35235b8587779d69ae.png
 As you progress through the game, you'll also see much more creatures with armor! 
 Every creature can spawn with armor now. 
 Each specie has its own predetermined type of armor and damage.

Speed of the Recall's Orb
Previously, the recall’s orb was too fast and the adorer was able to spam creatures. You could almost recall and summon it instantly. 

The recall mechanic was a must in almost every situation. Don't get us wrong, we love this mechanic! But now you have more choices.
You can still recall it, and while the orb is returning, It can be more efficient to use other creatures. Or instead of recalling it, you also have a more viable option of waiting for the creature to finish all its animations and returning by touch to you without locking your stamina(with the recall).

Charging the creature's Special Ability
In the last patch, you could just use one creature and it would charge all its Special Ability by itself. This, combined with the old recall's orb high speed, allowed and even incentivized the player to use just one creature.

We are changing it. Now, the creature that deals the damage will not charge its own special ability. But it will charge the special ability of all other creatures.


That's it! We had so much more fun with these changes. The moment-to-moment combat is much more engaging now. You really need to know when is the right moment to use each creature that you bring with you. Hope you also enjoy it!

Gems
In the first devlog we've mentioned the dungeon rewards, and these rewards are Gems!
The Gems are used to power up your artifacts. 
They will provide different effects on the adorer, giving you even more options to customize your builds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/32ccf3b4f900e6ff34f86f8e9ac0c616eb7c7fad.png

Here are the effects of the gems:

 Evasion
 Increase Staff ability charge rate
 Frenzy Summon: there is a chance to summon a creature in frenzy. A creature that is in frenzy, will deal more damage and have more attack speed.
 Lucky Summon:  there is a chance to summon a creature without spending stamina.
 Increase Health Points
 Increase Stamina Regeneration
 Increase Movement Speed
 Increase Recall Orb speed.

- You can only have one type of gem on each artifact.
- You can remove gems from artifacts, but you'll lose the gem.
- To attach a gem, your artifact needs one quality level for each gem. For example, an artifact with quality level 3 can have up to 3 gems!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1932624842465958375/EC2A66FC12A421B3C79C2E312A7391E472342F65/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false


Inventory rework

Artifacts were very powerful before and with the new gem system they are broken!
So we are introducing an artifact quality level cap to your inventory.
This will not only help to balance the artifacts, similar to how Rune System works, but will open path to more complex and in-depth builds!

Now, you will have 12 points that will be available to be distributed along the six slots of artifacts.
These points will determine the quality of the artifact that can be equipped in that slot, without losing any effect.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1932624842465754824/9994614427888F5C3E7D982A38DAF66E4F9F55D4/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

For example, to equip a quality 2 artifact with full power, you'll need a quality 2 inventory slot.

- These points are totally interchangeable. You can freely decrease and increase them to adapt your inventory.
- You naturally unlock more points by unlocking new artifacts' slots.
- You can equip a high-quality artifact on a low-quality slot. But the effect of the artifact will be capped to the quality of the slot.

notes.title: 0.10.1 - Removing the Energy System
notes.content:
Hi, fellow adorers!

It's been about 6 months that we've been receiving feedback and discussing with the community about the Energy System.
We finally decided to remove it! But this triggers some holes in the game design, so we had tweaked other mechanics to better fit the new system and keep the game challenging and engaging.

Basically, we'll not force the rotation of your creatures anymore. It'll totally depend on you and how you handle your creatures.

Cursed Creatures
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849296835283817732/A6868B2F7E3A64009F3842A06B3F07DA51037FA2/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
Now your creatures can be cursed!
We merged the old Critical Health + Exhaustion system together and simplified them.

If your creature reaches 1 HP, they will get cursed. As you know, the world of Gaterdrik is suffering from a curse that is spreading through all the creatures. So take care of your creatures.

A positive point against the old exhaust system is that now your creatures, even cursed, do not lose attack power! They can still use their Special Ability normally and costs 1 bar of Stamina to summon.

While your creatures have 1 HP, the adorer will still absorb the damage to prevent the creature from dying, but now you can't heal your cursed creatures.

So, how do you remove the curse? There are two ways:
[olist]
 Leave them purifying at the Sanctuary.
 Apply Divine Protection to your creature.
[/olist]

Divine Protection
You can find Divine Protection in holy fruits. Just give them to your creature and it will purify them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/957b9d4e94cc71352d2bc2adaa5412abc89bf900.png

Divine Protection can also be applied beforehand. Preventing a creature from becoming cursed during combat, bringing more protection to your creatures.

notes.title: Adore Update 10 - Devlog 2
notes.content:
Hi, adorers!

Here are the big changes that you've been asking for! We loved playing with them. I would say that it is the final step of the transition from the Roguelike genre. And from now on, we can aim to create a lot of content and plan for the 1.0 release.

If you missed the last devlog, here is the link: Devlog 1 - Blessed & Enraged creatures.

So, what's new?


Essences

Essences are used to create synergies between your creatures and they are now permanent! After some turns, they do not disappear anymore.

To find an Essence, you need to capture a creature. The type of this creature will determine which type of essence it will drop: Beast, Nature, Mystic, Arcane or Dragon.

They are also directly related to the blessed creatures (Devlog 1 - Blessed & Enraged creatures) and a bit harder to acquire. 

Small Essences are dropped from Normal creatures:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/92ca1a0344655de07e24f133f90d9f092e674d83.png

Medium Essences are dropped from Blessed creatures:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/ff761df1a9cf77ccde64b87d7b1cda9d6ba4ea75.png

Big Essences are dropped from Super Blessed creatures:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/892f53aeaa94fae0ac55ca6fec33cd5e248c67bb.png


Synergies

Synergies are also permanent and you can choose what ability the synergy will create!
Depending on the level of your creature, it will have more ability options to choose from.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849294930839539316/D3393A8E1BFA50163188DF658FF35CD8B4720857/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

To Upgrade to a level 2 synergy, now you need a Medium Essence. You cannot sum two small essences anymore. So here comes the importance of finding and capturing Blessed Creatures! Blessed and Super Blessed creatures are the ones who drop Medium(level 2) and Big(level 3) essences.

Some rules:

 Each creature can only have one synergy of each type.
 There is a limit of 6 points of synergies for each creature. 
 You can reset the synergies of your creature using Fragments


Artifacts

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849294879025072106/E8F25C5F4D843459D784EC16E4E576D071A4506E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

We removed the durability from Artifacts(new name to the items). They are also permanent now!

In the village, in front of your house, you'll be able to find a chest that will contain all your artifacts and materials. 
You can equip up to six artifacts at the same time and you are free to change them at any time while in the village to better suit your build.

To acquire an artifact, you can buy them from Baldin, the Shopkeeper.
If you find any unidentified artifacts while in Gaterdrik, you can bring them to Baldin. He'll identify it and make it available in his store.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849294930835822820/C45B7E01841133F6E417E60A9CE5D50E8416A4AF/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false


Materials

We are introducing Materials to the game. They are resources that you find during your adventures and can be used to upgrade your artifacts.
Materials can have 3 levels of quality.

notes.content:
Hi, adorers!

We want to share with you what we've been working on these months and what to expect for Adore in 2022. 

Throughout the development process, we stayed in direct contact with the community, collecting feedback and learning a lot from you. All with one goal: to make Adore the best game possible.
The last update (Update 9 - Welcome Home) changed a lot of the gameplay loop and we are really glad about the direction it took. 

We want to present our 2022 roadmap which will have a lot of new content. However, we believe that we still need to fine-tune the foundation of our new gameplay loop that was introduced in Update 9. And that will be the focus of Update 10: adjusting the Synergy and Item system in addition to implementing amazing features like Blessed and Enraged Creatures.

Here is the list of the main features:

 Blessed and Enraged creatures!
 WASD Movement (as an alternative choice) 
 Permanent Synergies System (Abilities)
 45 new Synergies for the creatures
 Permanent and Upgradable Artifacts (Items)
 Ranged Creatures Rework
 Huge amount of quality of life improvements
 Bug fixes, optimizations, balances & much more!

And going forward, after Update 10, our goal is to have at least 3 more Major Updates before 1.0. They would be totally focused on new content like new creatures, new maps, new bosses, new synergies new quests & the main questline. 

Blessed Creatures

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/dced81dc5921127db29321930d2808aca78fad63.jpg

Blessed creatures have the potential to become stronger than normal creatures.

Normal creatures have from 1 to 14 trait points.
Blessed creatures can have from 15 to 19 traits points.
Super Blessed creatures will always have 20 traits points.  

They also have different visuals!

Capturing blessed creatures is done in stages.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849294879025694263/F9A5BDEE2896BD104FC1626B92C6386F18B67235/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Each stage consumes a Particle of Gaterdrik and makes the creature stronger.
So if you want to capture a Normal creature, it will cost you 1 Particle of Draknar. For Blessed creatures you'll need two Particles and for Super Blesseds don't forget to take 3 particles with you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/4bb5f2b5ebc2a93c94c9a5730ebf196635a3938d.png


Enraged

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1849294930835418273/D1E3D83876C21AEA4D02D033D62B72CBC4EFADCE/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

But be careful when dealing damage to a blessed creature, if it reaches zero health in one of the stages, it will become Enraged and can no longer be captured. 
Enraged creatures also need to be defeated in stages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/a45b4028aa04f48ab1e8faeeee8f15ea5c2f8e86.png

If you decide not to capture them or trigger by mistake the Enraged state, these creatures work similarly to an elite enemy as it will get stronger and provide a bigger challenge than usual, so be careful!


Another really important feature related to blessed creatures is Essences and how they drop from normal, blessed, and super blessed creatures. But we'll talk more about that in the next devlog!

notes.title: Adore 0.9 - Devlog 05
notes.content:
Hi, adorers. We are almost there!

We took a deep look into the creature's meta unlock system. 
The way it worked was using fragments to unlock creatures at the temple. And after unlocking one, you used to get a free creature that you unlocked. This is what normally happens in other Roguelites. You unlock a new weapon and it is already given to you as a reward.

The big problem is that this goes directly against the core experience in creature collecting games:
The feeling of going on an adventure to find and capture a new creature.

We fixed that. ːsteamhappyː

Bestiary
You no longer unlock new creatures using Fragments.
Now, as you progress into the game and get deeper into the maps of Gaterdrik, new creatures naturally start appearing.
You'll be able to see in your bestiary how many creatures you can to find and how many are still locked.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1777225379184397050/AD93D3F8F9E9D57AEFFE758EFD2C4898562CED2E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
After you capture a creature, it will show and register its picture, model and information.
You can also check in your save slot (Options > Save Slots) how many unique creatures did you capture during your adventures.

Another addition is the unlimited number of creatures that you can capture. 
How that will work if, for example, your Sanctuary slots are full?
Basically, they will go to a reserve and, at any point, if you have Sanctuary Slots, you can create a bond with those creatures that you captured before. After that, you can start using and training them.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1777225379184423815/45EC57817FEE4183523506F4A6A4F75D81A7251D/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Capture System
We also want to make capturing a bit more challenging. Not only find the creature and hold a button to capture. 
In other games, you have the Random factor when you throw the card, ball, etc... But the important feeling is that butterfly on your belly yelling "Please, please, please"
We evolved our capture mechanics, not in the direction of randomness, but to create more experiences and memories of you trying to capture a creature that you are excited about.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1777225379190712400/E311F6E2D0D040AC1CDDEF856E1E295F906DCE79/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
We've implemented a sweet spot. Basically, you need to be in the direction of the Sweet Spot of the creature to be able to capture it.
Also, now you can Walk with reduced movement speed while capturing!

 This sweet spot to capture will vary in size and animation depending on the rarity of the creature. 
 New Creatures Unlock per Depth, Quest or ???

Runes
Now that the game has so many mechanics, we decided to simplify the Rune System.
You no longer apply Runes to your creatures, they are equipped directly to the adorer.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1777225379184412566/CCFA2DFB092014909D9336FF8C770D2EF5EF4806/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false


 3 rune slots
 6 Rune points to distribute among your runes
 You can freely change the runes and points in the village

notes.title: Adore 0.9 - Devlog 04
notes.content:
Hi, adorers!
In this devlog, we'll talk more in detail about the new Creature Abilities and new Item system!

Essences
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/4115719270223972208/3F2214949B9D878BFD43F4D69408BFE152CFEFEC/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Before we dive into details of the abilities, let's talk about essences.
Essences are what define each type of creature in the world of Gaterdrik and they are used to create synergy between your creatures.

You can collect them in two ways:
[olist]
 If you kill a cursed creature, it has a chance of dropping an essence of its type.
 If you capture a creature, it will drop the essence of its type.
[/olist]
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/4115719270223976955/40BDDD928C5EF2B13B14509DA97C691F504B3208/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Abilities
The creatures' abilities are now permanent!
Each creature now has a random set of abilities. They are unlocked at level 2, 4 and 6. 
But here is the tricky part about it, they only work if they have synergy with another creature! It's similar to how it worked before, but now you create the synergies with the help of Maena, the trainer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/f9e78f59964a1249a977cc0f48dd33560fcc9d84.png

Some points about synergies & essences:

 If you leave the creature in the sanctuary, it will lose its synergies.
 The synergy has 3 levels of power.
 There are 3 sizes of each Essence, they provide 1, 2 or 3 points of synergy. 
 Every time you go back to the village, the synergies decrease by one level.
 You can apply more than one Essence of the same type to the ability, they will accumulate. 
 The essences that you don't use in that turn, will dissipate.
 Icons & UI! Now the abilities have Icons and a redesigned UI to improve the identification. 

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/4115719270225642779/D73D5E8E07CF089B2725D9BBFDBF27D89B8E502E/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
As we said before, you need essences that you collect, to create the synergies.
For example, if you apply a Nature Essence to the ability of your Obyx, you will need a Nature Creature to fight alongside Obyx. This will activate the synergy that you just created with the Essence.

Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/ff77d79bbc383519cb1468725758f6388d73b3c8.png
Some great reworks here to adapt the items into the new gameplay loop.
Now, Baldin, the Shopkeeper, will live with you in the village. Every time you go back to the village, he will have new items to sell.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/4115719270223980746/918B6545029324A6012E0D54CEDC0F751C64EBF8/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Also, we are introducing Item Quality and Durability to the items.
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/4115719270224024017/739BA2E5DD6BDADC5C83E5D5337604DD7E2FCF48/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

 Items with higher qualities have more durability and stronger bonuses. 
 You can find Items of Quality 1 and 2 in normal maps. But the Item chest will always have a Quality 3 item! Also, you can find Quality 3 items in Expeditions.
 If you buy an item that you already have, it will upgrade the quality and reset durability.
 [ Not implemented yet ] We want to implement in future updates, a way for you to repair an Item. We are still testing and thinking about this, but the idea is that every time that you repair it to reset the durability, it will lose 1 quality until it reaches 0 and breaks. 
 If you drop a new Unidentified Item, it will automatically identify it. You no longer need to use Fragments. We've found players not spending fragments to progress on the Item Meta, and items are so important in the game experience to create new exciting opportunities for combos, builds, etc...
 Gold is now permanent! We are still pondering if you should lose some of your gold if you die(maybe 20%).
 Redesigned UI. 

Just to remember, every time you go back to the village, all durabilities decrease by one.

We plan to release the Major Update this month, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Adore 0.9 - Devlog 03
notes.content:
Hi, adorers!
Today we are going to show more about the new gameplay loop of Adore.
As we said before, we believe that these changes will explore much more the potential that Adore has, while still maintaining the core gameplay, that we love, untouchable.

The game is leaning towards the Creature Collecting side, but also with strong Roguelite elements, such as incentivizing the player to adapt to different situations.


So what's new?

New Gameplay Loop
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1621850371379845485/410F10B6DE86D0DB411BC98C32B2714589B98D6B/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

Now, when you finish a map, you will return to the village. So, between your adventures, you'll be able to manage your team of creatures, their synergies, your items, consumables and runes!

Each time you go back to the village, it will count as a "turn". Everything is tied to the turn: Creatures energies, synergies, items, consumables, maps, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/4b7b0aeb63e3f080ef17f124d01f31ccaa108fc7.jpg

Expeditions
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1621850371379832588/813E67D60533994CF76494D01A59F2F554F62039/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

We loved this addition to the new gameplay loop. Basically, it brings back the feeling of a run.  
Expeditions can be short, medium, or long and you will have to complete multiple maps in just one go. They will have better rewards and some creatures that you can only find during Expeditions.

Draknar Statues & Traits
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1736692309172806999/5D424B8726C37FCAD7C11545615881825CF45F3F/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

After the golden era of the adorers, Draknar Statues became very rare. The only way to find them is to go on an Expedition. 
Every time you adore a Statue, your creatures will be blessed and increase their trait points bar so they can earn new traits.

More:

 As you progress into the game through quests, new maps will be unlocked and with them, new creatures. Also, new creatures can appear in the old maps as you get deeper into the Gaterdrik world.
 You can see what rewards you are getting before going to a map, this creates some interesting choices for the player.
 Every objective will also expire after a few turns, so plan your way carefully to not lose the rewards you want or need.
 You can sleep at your house. Your creatures will rest, healing and recovering one energy point. But all durabilities(items, objectives, synergies, food) will decrease.
 Each day(turn), every creature in the sanctuary will recovery one energy point and heal.



We plan to release the Major Update this month, so stay tuned.

Follow the development more closely at our discord server: Cadabra Discord. 
Also, feel free to talk directly to the devs and send us any suggestions or critiques.

See you!

Hi, fellow adorers!
Today we are going to talk about our new Cooking & Consumables System.

We think that Adore is lacking in that extra care with your creatures. That time that you relax a bit from the action and take care of them. And the cooking system is here to improve this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/50cbd12ebb884b6138e8c81d5b5f8a4f0b7ec8d2.jpg

Consumables
First, you need to collect the ingredients during your adventures through Gaterdrik.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1684898325001213239/C491CA2AB3E09CC4D2F99F0815D7DEB2F3234368/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1684898325001219004/0174FC5263618A56FBD9BD568A0C58C999120AB7/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1684898325001221993/7172B80CCF3A7BD3E84C2DBB018306F1AE606872/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

There are five types of them:

 Meat: Health
 Fruits: Health + Energy
 Bugs: Health + Traits
 Mushrooms: Traits + Health
 Honey: Energy + Health

Basically, they have a primary effect and, most of the time, a secondary one.

So, what does that mean?
You can consume or give to your creatures any of the ingredients you collected. But if you combine and cook the ingredients, the effects will accumulate and the primary ones will be boosted!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1684898325003941116/59C855EFF2C95278739CD36EEFB14A0EDDA039A3/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

More about the effects:
Health: Heals the target
Energy: Recovery Energy(we'll talk more about this on one of the next devlogs)
Traits: Give the creature temporary traits!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1684898325003969270/7D69A3D9F1F2362ECB37D365D47928312D3FA024/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

notes.title: Balancing Quick Events
notes.content:
Hi, Adorers!
Thank you very much for all the feedback that you send to us.

Our intention with the Quick Events was to create new combat situations for the player to leave the comfort zone. It worked really well!
However, other situations arose that we did not like, for example, being able to go through events without needing to kill a single enemy.
So we've made some changes:

Escort the Orb
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1774959629580810585/10AC701C3E1F75837C36DB04EC190B300173B560/
Now, every time an enemy steps into the orb radius, the energy orb will stop moving. It will also change the color of the indicator to yellow.
To balance this we:
- Increased the orb speed from 3 to 4.5.
- (Normal difficult) The interval between creatures spawns increased from 5s to 6s. 
- (Insane difficult) The interval between creatures spawns increased from 2s to 5s. 


Activate the Energy Mechanism
In this event, we have adjusted some values to value the player who eliminates the enemies.

- (Normal difficult)When the player is not on top of the mechanism, the energy drop rate changed from 0.5 to 0.7.
- (Normal difficult) The interval between creatures spawns increased from 5s to 6s. 

- (Insane difficult)When the player is not on top of the mechanism, the energy drop rate changed from 0.7 to 1.
- (Insane difficult) The interval between creatures spawns increased from 2s to 5s. 

Bug Fixes & changes
- The old bestiary has been removed from the temple. Now you can access the new one from anywhere opening the Adorers Panel.
- Fixed Players not being able to summon creatures in some situations. 
- Fixed some cases that the creatures were being duplicated after being deposited at the Shrine of the Adorers.
- Controller: Removed the button to change from Normal to Insane mode during the run.
- Fixed a bug where you finished generating the orb and started to capture a creature while moving(spoiler alert: a feature of the next patch!)
- Fixed being able to generate another energy orb.

We believe these changes will make the quick events even more fun. 

You can follow the development more closely at our Discord server.
Also, feel free to talk directly to the devs and send us any suggestions or critiques.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 8 - Quick Events
notes.content:
Hello, Adorers!
With this patch, we're introducing Quick Events.
They are minigames that will show up in each map to improve variety and stimulate interesting gameplays.

Escort the Energy Orb 
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1800854897981982318/51E181B47C105AC9FB6E8664077D54A8A738DB53/

The objective in this event is to channel the energy of your staff and generate an Energy Orb, then escort it to a Sentinel Tower.
After bringing all the required orbs, the tower will purify the area.


 The orb will follow the Adorer.
 Cursed creatures will keep spawning until the Sentinel Tower is activated.
 If you move away from the orb, it will stop moving.
 Eliminating creatures will not reward you with gold or experience. But, when the event is finished, you will receive both.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1800854897981986002/8EC22B149C107C185EC23699C3EEF6395A7CC820/

Activate the Energy Mechanisms
During this event you will need to use your creatures wisely, since the adorer's movement will be a little hindered.
The objective is to activate all mechanisms by triggering them until their energy peaks and the four flames are lit up.

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1800854953422511219/0370FBC6C608E212B18D759D0BFB4C1FA7B784E3/

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1800854953422500395/B316EABFB3E319607CCDCADFAE5B4DA97B52E63A/

 Level 1: Eliminate 10 creatures. Reward: 15 gold coins

You, as an adorer, need to feel powerful summoning your creatures!

Staff Ability

notes.title: 0.6.2 - Permanent Progression
notes.content:
Hi, adorers!
We have received a lot of feedback on the new patch and it has made us stop and rethink the fundamentals of Adore.

We know that it is impossible to please everyone and in the end we have to follow the idea of ​​how Cadabra Games imagines Adore.
But the feedback has proved to be very valid and we agree with most of them.

Here are the changes:

REWORKS
- Now you don't need to spend an Essence to use the Draknar Statue.
- You begin with all creature slots(of the player) unlocked. No need to spend Draknar Statues to unlock slots.
- You can save your creatures even if they are with Critical Health.

BALANCES
- Now you start the run with 2 Essences.
- Level cap of your creatures increased from 5 to 10.
- Draknar Statues now appears between 6 to 8 times in the run.

BUG FIXES
- Fixed: while Adoring a Draknar Statue all the slots would not be visible.
- Fixed: the minimap was overlaping multiple levels.
- Fixed: dialogues bugs.
- Fixed: human bosses would not be poisoned.
- Fixed: the creature's energy would follow the player around after selecting a creature from the sanctuary.

This is a first step implementing a better Permanent Progression System to make Adore more rogueLITE instead of rogueLIKE. 
For the next days, we are going to work on giving you more options to personalise permanently your creatures. Stay tuned.

This changes will naturally make the game easier, but also much more fun. 
If you are a hardcore player, don't worry we'll implement a new insane/hardcore mode so you can test your skills to the limit.

You can follow the development more closely at our discord server: Cadabra Discord.
Also, feel free to talk directly to the devs and send us any suggestions or critiques.

Have fun!

BALANCE
- Increased how many times the Shopkeeper appears in the run: from 2(min)/3(max) to 3(min)/4(max)
- Increased how many statues of Draknar appears in the run: from 6(min)/8(max) to 8(min)/10(max)
- Increased how many Essences appear in the run: from 4(min)/6(max) to 6(min)/8(max)

notes.title: Adore 0.6 - Devlog 2
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! One more talk  before we release the Adore 0.6 Major Update.

You can check our previous Devlog at:
Adore 0.6 - Major Update Devlog 01


Critical Health!

This rework is to address one fundamental problem that follows us since closed beta builds:
If your creature dies, you lose attacking power.  Especially in Boss fights, this can make the fight very boring and slow. 

Because our game has a very unique and innovative gameplay, we have to explore places that no one has tested before. We tried numerous solutions to the problem, several of them ended up smoothing the problem(like spawning creatures in boss fights so you can capture them) but we were never 100% satisfied. For example, now that we are introducing more Human Boss fights, there is no creature spawning, and capturing another adorer's creature is not an option.

So we decided: your creatures cannot go below 1 health!


How it will work?

The adorers love their creatures and they will do everything to save them. The creatures are as precious as the adorer's life! 
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1754684793159637899/881474679C8D79D16B3ACA382DF69980D279F516/

1. If the creature enters critical health (25% of their Maximum health) the adorer will start to protect it with its own life, receiving 50% of all incoming damage to the creature. 
2. Any fatal damage that the creature would receive, the adorer will absorve 100%  to keep his creature alive.
3. If the adorer dies, creatures with critical health are too fragile and do not resist. So you cannot save creatures with critical health on the Sanctuary!

The idea of creatures not dying had crossed our minds in the past, but not in the way we implemented it now. The big catch is the adorer protecting the creatures with his own life when the creature enters Critical Health. 
That way you'll not think like: "Oh, this creature won’t die, it’s invincible, so I’ll use it at will to tank damage". Quite the contrary, now you end up being even more careful with it, as it can kill you if it takes damage. Also, if you die, you cannot save the creature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/1ebcfbff9c486b34fd0d24416d02627a4bfb558e.png

The fact that you cannot save creatures when they are in critical health is another pillar of this structure. Once you could save them, you would never lose your creatures. And its creatures to die permanently is something essential that we would not abandon.

Critical Health: The adorer will take damage to prevent the death of his creature. If the adorer dies, creatures with critical health cannot be saved on the Sanctuary.

(We used the old Kaiv'anne name and icon).

notes.title: The Clunky Update
notes.content:
Hi, Adorers!

We really pay attention to every feedback that everyone gives. Sometimes we can't answer all the messages because our team is very small. But we read all of them!

Since our Early Acess launch, Adore has been receiving more than 91% POSITIVE REVIEWS! That's amazing. It's our first game, a game that we put so much love on and it's being well received. We really thank you for that!

Among the negative reviews, there are a lot of good points that we agree and we'll work on. 
But here and there, it kept popping reviews telling that the game "feels clunky". 
It was really hard to find out what that means to fix it. We asked the players and even they did not know what to say exactly.

Here are some quotes of reviews/feedback that we received.

"Adore just felt clunky for me. I liked the idea of fighting with just abilities..."
"The concept is great, but the summon time feels slow..."

But after lots of effort trying to find this "clunky feel", we realized it was about the Summoning Action being canceled if you do not hold the button for 0.15s(summoning time):
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1665730758168741529/7187CF36F730B1B08BE295FB511B89786D992B6D/


Seams small, but it was a big change for the game. 
We reworked, from the ground, how summoning works and it should feel much more fluid and responsive now!

Hope this small(but big) change, makes Adore even better.

Thank you for all the feedback.
Have fun!

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686289937013/ED9FA32153A4118647CCC449C236CBFE2A52845C/


Hi, Adorers! 
We have been listening closely to all community feedback and the most asked feature is a way to keep your creatures between runs.
We were a bit reluctant about that in the beginning because it could break a pillar of a good roguelite: Every run feeling different.
Gladly we found a way to merge the best of the two worlds and we are really excited for you to play and test it on June 30th!

Shrine of the Adorers - Creature Collecting System

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038590077192921653/A5B9AD4AEE2717791B1F4481E39700E77E30E473/

To keep your creatures, you start with one slot and can use your fragments to unlock new ones.

Between runs, you will not lose the level and traits (curses & bonds) of your creatures. 
They are Permanent. But the blessings of Draknar(synergies) that your creatures receive during the run, will dissipate. This will keep things fresh for each run!

Besides that, you can only leave the temple with one or two creatures. That depends if you want to spend all your Essences.

During the run, you can also use the Shrine to deposit or get your creatures(costs 1 Essence). 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/2e873710afeb9e9fbca583fac2faf3a7379cdf72.jpg


And of course, now you can rename your creatures! <3 
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038590077192919214/C6464188EEB085113A47641619F97D10447D2448/


Trait System

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686290731395/E668CD7784E8992FD1E8DBD611EA9AF4BC1F4E8E/

Every creature now feels different! You can have two Dommus, but each one of them will have unique traits.
The traits have two types: Bonds and Curses. 

Bonds are strong ties that grow between you and your creatures. The more you use them, the higher is the chance of your creature creating a bond with you.

Leech: The creature's attacks have a chance to recover health.
Blessed: Chance of not spending stamina when summoned.
Agressive: Increased attack speed.
Voracious: Increased damage against one type of creature.
Swift: Increased movement speed.
Greedy: Chance of dropping extra gold from killed creatures.
Accurate: Critical attack chance.
Energetic: Special energy increases faster.
Healthy: Heals more from healing effects. 
Tough: Increased max health.

Curses: If you expose your creature to the world of Gaterdrik, that is under a big curse, it increases the chance of 'infecting' your creature.

Sluggish: Reduced attack speed.
Fragile: The creature receives more damage.
Unified: The adorer receives damage when its creature gets hit.
Weary: Has a chance of spending all your stamina to summon.
Lethargic: Special energy increases slower.
Weak: Reduced attack damage.
Slow: Reduced move speed.

- Purify Creatures: You can clean the curses using the Purify totem on the temple. After you leave the creature purifying, it will remove the curses gradually while you are playing.


Thank you very much for all the feedback! 

Don't forget to join our community:
https://discord.gg/9C8B2hK


Draknar bless us all.

notes.title: Devlog: New creatures, new Boss, new map & more!
notes.content:
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686289774558/67214E375A9202E2BD5ED990836D31C6D624E77D/


Hi, Adorers! 
This will be our biggest update so far. We have 4 new creatures, a brand new map, new items, a trait system and a creature collecting system, where you will be able to keep your favorite creatures with you.

The Major Update is coming at the end of June.

For today, we'll talk about the creatures!

New Creatures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/670300784d73208ebc1debb2f6ffce09f19d758f.png

– Obyx [Arcane]


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686289559753/1DB2C96AD3B31B68619218ED9E5DC1AF93035168/

Obyx can create insane combos opportunities with his gravitational arcane powers. A great choice if you are looking for crowd control.

Special Attack: When his orb hits a target, it creates a gravitational energy that sucks together all foes in the area.

Obyxs are incredible creatures, both for their unique diet habits and for their supernatural abilities. Its restrictive and differentiated diet is totally based on minerals and stones, from the most common to the rarest ones. For this reason, it is usual to find reports of Obyxs always hanging in rocky mountains, abandoned mines, caves and even wandering around, looking for new minerals.

Despite being a tireless crusher and devourer of any rock or mineral, Obxys are obsessed with one in particular: a precious mineral known as Dranita. This rare mineral is responsible for charging the source of its arcane abilities, as it has special properties from the early days of the planet, on a time when Draknar still used to walk through the immensity of Gaterdrik.

For the Obyxs, finding Dranita is a simple but exhausting task. Their connection with the arcane mineral is so powerful that they sense the vibrations from the smallest of the stones, so they use their powerful jaw to open paths crushing dirt, gravel and hard rocks. Frequently living in small groups, they usually do not have great difficulties in finding incredible mineral deposits and then living nearby for long periods.

Now, for the Established Realms, finding Dranita is an almost impossible task, especially in quantities relevant enough to craft something useful. The rare mineral is found in many different locations, without any pattern, this means that it could be found in large rocky mountains or even in a hot and arid desert. This is not to say that humans never found a bit of it. The few reports from small sources of Dranita found was followed by furious Obyxs protecting their greatest treasure, using brutal arcane forces to ward off invaders, using gravitational fields to drag them away straight to precipices or throwing huge rocks on their heads.

One of the greatest fears of the Adorers is that one day the Established Realms will be able to find a deposit of Dranita without protection from the Obyxs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/6f59d7cf13c73268b7f8d9360428015f0b01ae8c.png

– Dommu [Nature]


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686289645640/1E5FA232B8D25174DCD6D8695B69B6D6026C7CE5/

Dommu is a support creature designed to keep your other creatures healthy. But she also has great damage potential if used in certain situations. That's because her orbs pierce the target.

Special Attack: When summoned, it creates a huge magic area. If any of your creatures are inside the area when they deal damage, it will heal a percentage of their health.

Each being carries within them a spark of Draknar, the god of Gaterdrik. However, for some reason unknown to the Adorers, this connection occurs differently with the Dommus. These magnificent creatures are not directly connected to divinity, but to Gaterdrik, and such connection begins on the day of their birth. The moment that they are between life and death.

As the females approach the last week of gestation, the herd gathers to start a relentless search for a Solar Glade in the middle of the dense forests they inhabit. Upon finding the sacred site, the females lie on the ground, all very close to each other and stay there until their foal are ready to born. Males, on the other hand, work on two fronts, some go in search of food, while others stay around to protect them from possible predators. Something that has not been reported yet, as if the other creatures respect this sacred moment.

When the day finally comes, the sun bathes the clearing with all its heat and the calf is ready to come to life. The female gets up and starts walking around the clearing until finally the calf is born. The fragile calf falls to the ground very weak as if it is struggling to live, gradually with a colossal effort, it manages to get up, but its strength is not enough to keep it standing for a long time. So, the parents, admired by the effort of their child, begin to perform what the Adorers calls the Ogham dance. A sacred ritual in which it is possible to hear the heart of Nature.

Their parents begin to surround him, marching and shaking their heads from side to side in a slow and rhythmic movement. Gradually, a small greenish cloud begins to come out of their horns and envelop its foal. In the middle of the dense cloud, the horn of the newborn Dommu, which still has a central opening, begins to suck the entire green cloud created by its parents. After the cloud is completely consumed, the male and the female both approach the calf, now completely healthy and strong, lower their heads so that their calf can touch his horn on theirs and thus end the sacred dance.

Some Adorers believe that, in the very distant past, the Dommus were spiritual creatures who broke through the barrier of plans just to live in Gaterdrik, as they admired their grandeur and beauty.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/fa1e4070d85dc3fcca17bad7ab2d5c958a23db5c.png

– Nira [Nature]


https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589480629611877/994663055CC04A31264720C38D0459D96F00C0B6/

Nature Team now has a real dps creature. Nira doesn´t have huge direct damage, but don't mess with her poison, it can melt the health of her foes down. 
Also, she has great mobility between attacks, it can be hard for the enemy to catch her.

Special Attack: Each attack inflicts poison status.

Niras are simple creatures with no refinement, either from their way of life or to their ability to defend the den and their group. Despite being poorly organized, Nira usually lives in large groups, always close to the vast orchards of Ookoo, using the thick roots of this large fruit tree as a base for their burrows.

Like almost everything in Gaterdrik, there is a divine balance between the Niras and the Ookoo trees. While the Niras offer extra protection against humans who want to collect Gaterdrik's wonderful fruits, the Ookoo trees offer them a safe and abundant in resources environment for the creatures to spend a lifetime.

The abundant food supply and protection is what guarantees the perpetuation of the Niras. Without the benefit guaranteed by the Ookoo trees, they would certainly be extinct. This would be due to two factors, first, their lack of ability to get food. Niras are disorganized and terrible at catching small insects. The second factor, perhaps the most relevant, they spend more than half of their lives without any mechanism of defense, thus needing older Niras and protection of trees.

During the first part of their life, the Niras still don’t have the fatal tail that makes them so feared by those who wander in Gaterdrik. Instead, there are a few long and loose threads that start from their forehead to the end of their backs, as if it were a type of hair that protects their entire back. Then, through instinct, Niras start rubbing their backs against the roots of Ookoo, and thus the sap that comes out of the tree unites all these threads, creating a thin and solid carapace over time. While this carapace is being created, a thin stinger, which is very similar to a strand of hair, breaks from the top of its head and begins to tangle with the other strands along with the carapace and being exposed at the end.

Once their tail is finished and the carapace hardens, Nira can finally venture into the vicinity of the den, defend itself against the onslaught of other creatures and deal with overly curious humans.

Looking from a distance, they may not seem very intimidating, but an adult Nira must be respected since, in the second half of life, they become one of Gatedrik's most lethal creatures. Even after being defeated, a single touch of your stinger can kill an adult Breor in full form. Humans, on the other hand, avoids the orchards of Ookoo, and when they find one, they end up setting fire to it since until today nobody has been able to create or discover an antidote to get rid of certain death that comes with finding one.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/925a918ff2bf814ecb67f80d9712df13546a3b97.png


– Zhoraz [Beast] | Demigod

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1038589686290083833/E07DAB57F9F564A30456B00BF7C18A7878A68D4E/

Our first new Demigod creature is a Beast. We won't spoil too much about him here. Good luck!


In forgotten times, when demigods walked peacefully through Gaterdrik, Zhoraz was known as the purifier. His responsibility was to control plagues and maintain the balance necessary for life to flow exactly as Draknar had planned.

After some eras taking care of the habitats, its function had to be adapted as the Great Capitals began to advance inside Gaterdrik, creating huge walls, war enclosures, small villages and even mines to collect resources to supply the insane war of humans. After seeing all the devastation they were causing to his home, Zhoraz was overcome by a relentless fury, initiating an onslaught that would mark the history of both creatures and humans.

The big capital Tenéios was the first to feel the power of the demigod. With so much sadness and anger inside of him, Zhoraz condensed everything he was feeling and made the biggest leap in his entire life towards the gates of the capital. When he hit the ground, it triggered an incandescent area of fire that turned the gates into ashes.

Then, running like a huge reptile, he entered the city charging with its huge fangs against the war machines, destroying them with great ease. The soldiers who tried in vain to fight back using their muskets, which did not pierce his thick skin, started to retreat and evacuate all the population. All the buildings of Tenéios were taken down by Zhoraz and the capital ended up devastated. 

This overpowering attack initiated a movement known as the Established Realms, where all the Great Capitals ceased their wars for power, terrain and wealth, and focused all their might on Gaterdrik. This war would go on for years and mark not only history, but also the whole planet.

Thus, outside of Gaterdrik, Zhoraz became known as an apocalyptic legend that brings pain and suffering wherever it goes. But inside his home, he is still known as the Purifier.


In the next post, we'll share more about the Creature Collecting and Trait system! Stay tuned.

Don't forget to join our community:  
https://discord.gg/9C8B2hK

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/652db0dc7b64367c240d3ee2a40e3aae1fa4b371.jpg

Hi, Adorers! 
This is our biggest update so far. We have a lot of new things to share with you. 
First of all, we want to thank you so much for all the critiques and feedbacks. We drastically changed our plans for the future based on the community feedback. Check the end of the post to know more about our Roadmap.

Here are the Patch notes:

New Creatures!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/a9bdadeb0d105462a4c9a764fcdf3868013d4a41.png 
– Zarkee [Mystic]

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/778500534362107964/CCE120D896A6919F5B12C8FB323764355B25F56E/
Zarkee is a unique creature that needs to channel his attack before performing it. It deals a huge damage, but the channeling aspect makes him a very high risk/reward creature.

Special Attack: After hitting the first target, Zarkee jumps to another enemy nearby, repeating it one more time(it can come back to the first target).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/c9d1a10184a6010a240f1a200eb098a24ba984d1.png 
– Breor [Beast]

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/778500534362135606/2E67C48F50131A5BE6722F60B9673C92B5B79C8B/
Breor is a tank designed to create space for the player. 
His slow attacks keep him in the field for a longer period of time and his armor will absorb all the damage received. 

Special Attack: When summoned, stuns all enemies around himself. For each enemy hit, gains an amount of Armor.

Armor: Ignore all negative effects (stun, freeze, slow, knockback, stagger).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/bfc2b8b007ba34f82aba92093f449c52a9790d73.png 
– Frogma [Mystic]

https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/778500534362119434/AC892FEA914B8D525243EA38D90BAC8A69BE6065/
Frogma throws a lava projectile that hits any enemy in his path. After hitting the enemy, it creates a lava puddle that deals damage per second to any foe inside it.

Special Attack: In each attack, Frogma throws two extra projectiles.

New Game + & ++
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1010436083543410153/9C6DBF437A2CA97B4FF1B285075203FB8EBE2107/
Our game has lots of innovation mechanics and that makes the learning curve a bit high at your first playthroughs. Because of that, Adore was balanced easier than we wanted. But once the players get usual to the new gameplay style of Adore, the game becomes much easier. 
To solve that, we are introducing two new difficulty modes:
Strong Curse Power
Insane Curse Power

You need to beat the current mode that you are in, to play the next one.

New Stamina System
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1010436083543415601/364E8E5F86EB88D64657A9C150A54E091CE19FA6/
The previous system was enabling the player to spam all 4 creatures at the same time to attack a target. That's not what we want for our game(a mindless button smash). 
We want Adore to have a strategic fight where you need to choose the best creature to invoke in each situation.

- With the new stamina system, you have 2 bars, each summoned creature consumes one bar.
- Dodge and Recall now don't cost stamina. But they stop the stamina recovery for 1 second.
- We significantly increased the stamina recovery, so you can keep your combos.
- The game has strong stamina management and we decided to put the new stamina UI on the character's foot, so you can visualize it better.

Mechanics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/dd1c89883d6620710630e7ac979822ab9801f10e.png
 - Pact with Draknar(New!): At any time, you can offer your maximum health in exchange for an essence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/68c1c7f91471531a45aba240050902bb4a22cf6f.png
- Return by Touch: If your creature returns to you by touch, you gain 1 stamina bar.
(This was previously an item. but we moved to an unlockable mechanic due to the new stamina system).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/c48ba02c499c0a894414e0eebe643f7ac6df7ee9.png
- Walk Control: You can take full control of the movement of your creature.

Implementations
- [ Community Suggestion ] - The name of the bosses now appears in their health bar.
- Now, cursed creatures spawn on boss fights.
It will make the boss fights more dynamic and there was some situation were your creatures die in the boss fights and you end up with few creatures, support creatures or even with no creature. 
Even if you have no essence, you now can use the new mechanic "Pact with Draknar"(described further in this patch notes) to trade 30 maximum health for an essence.

- Spawned creatures don't give XP and Gold.
- The essence bonus now gives you + 10% of stamina regeneration instead of maximum stamina.


Balance
- [ Community Suggestion ] - On the Regular difficulty, bosses deal less damage and have less health.
- [ Community Suggestion ] - Fragment's drop rate increased from 10% to 25%.
- Abbu's synergy now gives 2 extra orbs instead of 3.
- Abbu's synergy now gives 15% attack speed instead of 30%.

Adjustments
- [ Community Suggestion ] - Krongur Rework (Stone Monkey boss). New effect to indicate the rock spawn position.
 Krongur's charge now stops chasing the target if it's close to it.
 Krongur's rock attack now divides into three pieces.
- [ Community Suggestion ] (Mouse & Keyboard) Interact button now changed from left mouse to "F".
- Dodge and Recall now don't cost stamina. But they stop the stamina recovery for 1 second.
- The items Dodging Claw and Winged Sandals don't cost any stamina now.
- General optimizations in performance
- All the items that used to increase player's maximum stamina now increase player's stamina regeneration.
- Adjusted all selected circles on the foot of the creatures.
- The creatures of the player now have an increased stagger resist (only at Regular difficulty).
- Tutorial rework with the new implementations.
- Reordered all unlockable mechanics, creatures and items.
- Adjustments to the Score Screen.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the player could not see the fragment behind the environment.
- Fixed the VFX of Azuno's slow not appearing on the target.
- Fixed a bug involving Felwin's death.
- Fixed a bug that was causing the player to dodge in a random direction.
- Fixed a Pot at Gaterdrik's forest that was impossible to break.
- Fixed a bug when using the statue would freeze the player's animation.
- Fixed a bug causing Meecra(from the last boss) to stop.
- Fixed a bug allowing the player to recall disabled creatures.

Roadmap
We received lots of feedback regarding being able to keep your creatures. We thought that would break the variety of each run, a pillar of roguelikes/lites. But we've been discussing about that and we finally found great ideas to implement Creature Collecting in our game. 
That will be the focus of our next Major update: Creature Collecting. 
Stay tuned.

notes.title: New mystic creature: Felwin!
notes.content:
Hi, Adorers! We are very happy to launch our first creature out of many to come: Felwin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34955966/c5569464d0e36efb5408bc9a9c0cbbdde6a5d935.jpg

During their lives, the tails of the Felwins change drastically. The females have the tail related to the cubs, the more cubs it has the more feathers on its tails it will have, the males have their tails linked to the number of fights won or prey slaughtered, the stronger and more vigorous the male, the more feathers on the tail it will own. For this reason, whenever a Felwin is seen with a single feather on its tail, it is certain that he is no longer a great fighter or is still too young to fight.

The feathers of the Felwins are a great mystery, all you know is that they are responsible for a strong bond between the Felwins of the same pack and give a thread of mystical fabric capable of strengthening bonds of families that use clothes made with him. As it is very difficult to get the tails and make this thread, generally only very rich or powerful families use it in their clothes, belts, cords, and bracelets.
